Attached: 4 images

First test of my new 1 L hydroponic pots, designed and 3D printed in PLA 🌱

One pot per plant (one plant = one biological replicate), a number engraved on each lid for traceability, an aeration port, and a 3D printed air splitter too. A wooden rack keeps everything in line. The design is fully customizable and scalable.

Next up: mineral nutrition experiments.

#Hydroponics #PlantScience #PlantNutrition #3DPrinting #OpenScience #PlantBiology #Research #Academy
